programs.title: Bloomberg New Economy
programs.sub_title: Thriving in an Age of Extremes
programs.desc: Candid conversations with CEOs, investors, and government leaders focused on how to navigate and prosper in this age of economic uncertainty. Hosted by Erik Schatzker in Singapore.

programs.title: Bloomberg Investigates
programs.sub_title: Inside the Legal Fight Against Trump's Deportation Campaign
programs.desc: Spending a year following a group of lawyers as they sue the Department of Homeland Security and scramble to help free those arrested under Donald Trump's immigration policies.

programs.title: Leaders with Francine Lacqua: The Podcast
programs.sub_title: Blackstone's Jon Gray on Talent, Loyalty and Building a $1.3 Trillion Wall Street Giant
programs.desc: Francine Lacqua speaks with Blackstone President Jon Gray; he reflects on leading through crises, highlighting the firm's difficult Hilton deal as a lesson in staying calm, backing strong businesses and thinking long-term; he also emphasizes the importance of resilience, clear decision-making and maintaining humanity in leadership, especially during tough times.

programs.title: Bloomberg Chief Future Officer
programs.desc: Gina Goetter is the CFO and COO of Hasbro; she's the architect of the company's transformation, while diversifying its manufacturing footprint and investing in Hasbro's video game ambitions.

programs.title: Posthuman
programs.desc: Emily Chang meets some of the world's most advanced and most intelligent, robots; will the creation of a synthetic species with human-like intelligence improve the human experience, or end it?

programs.title: Bloomberg Primer
programs.sub_title: Making New Nuclear Fuel for an Atomic Renaissance
programs.desc: Nuclear power is attempting a comeback, but producing the necessary fuel is complex; from mining to enrichment, can new technologies and supply chains scale to power the next generation of reactors?
